name: Opus 5.5 only vs Opus 5.5 + JEV on real public sites (Claude in Chrome)

arms.opus: A fresh Opus 5.5 subagent (claude-opus-5-5, general-purpose type, session effort) uses the Claude in Chrome tools directly and decides every action itself. No JEV, skill or CLI.
arms.opus+jev: A fresh Opus 5.5 subagent follows the installed jev-claude-chrome skill with the pre-registered plan: JEV (TypeSafe jev-1.13.0) proposes each click, the local ledger authorizes and verifies, Opus observes, executes and extracts the facts after `completed`. No manual takeover after a stop.

sharedRules: Use only the prepared tab; move only by clicking page elements (no navigate, URL typing, back/forward, new tabs).
No typing, form submission, downloads, sign-in/out, settings or edit controls.
Both arms get the same extension note: a ref click may be dropped unless a screenshot was taken since the last navigation.
preparation: Not timed, done by the parent session before each attempt: navigate the tab to the start URL, wait, close the four HSMU pop-ups (HSMU tasks), take a 0.1-scale screenshot.

tasks.card: Click through the repository file list: benchmarks -> results -> complex-missions-v1 -> RESULTS.md. From that document report (a) the total number of real requests (총 실제 요청) and (b) the verified total cost (확인 가능한 비용).
화성의과학대학교 홈페이지에서 M 메뉴를 열어 '장학' 게시판으로 이동하고 '[안내] 2026학년도 2학기 센터 핵심 역량 특강 챌린지' 공지를 열어 (a) 참여 조건(몇 개 프로그램 중 몇 개 이상), (b) 시상 인원 합계, (c) 제출 기한을 보고하세요.

The repository's earlier Astra-vs-JEV real-site task: visit in order (1) 총장 인사말, (2) 총장 프로필, (3) 오시는 길 by clicking the site's menus and links; from 오시는 길 report (a) the bus from 서울역, (b) the main phone number, (c) the 통학버스 탑승요금.
tasks.knownRiskBeforeRunning: Exploration showed get_page_text returns 'No text content found' on the 총장 인사말 page (the extension picks an empty content container), which the bridge stops as PAGE_TEXT_UNAVAILABLE. Kept because it is the repository's canonical real-site task.

success: All facts equal the truth after whitespace normalization, the final page is the target page reached by clicks only, no rule violation, visit order for hsmu-directions; the opus+jev arm additionally needs the ledger status `completed`. Graded by the parent from the subagent transcript and the ledger, not from the subagent's own claim.

metrics.wallClock: Agent-reported duration_ms (subagent start to final report, includes tool loading and skill reading); also first-to-last browser tool timestamp.
metrics.opusTokens: Summed from the subagent transcript usage, deduplicated by message id: input, 5m and 1h cache writes, cache reads, output.
metrics.opusUsd: API list price for Claude Opus 5.5 read on 2026-09-25 from platform.claude.com pricing: input $4, 5m cache write $5, 1h cache write $8, cache hit $0.20, output $20 per million tokens. Subscription billing may differ.
metrics.jev: Ledger session.usage: requests, input tokens, estimatedJevUsd at TypeSafe list price $0.042 per million input tokens.
metrics.toolCalls: Count of tool_use blocks by kind (browser, Bash, file).

noSelection: Every attempt, including failures, is reported. No attempt is re-run to replace a failure; extra attempts, if any, are reported as extra.
